title: Grade 2 Math — Mon, Jun 23
description: Money — Day 1 of 5: Recognising coins and notes
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which coin has the value of ₹5?
questions.explanation: The ₹5 coin is bigger than the ₹2 coin. Coins come in ₹1, ₹2, ₹5 and ₹10 denominations.

questions.question: How many ₹1 coins make ₹5?
questions.explanation: 5 coins of ₹1 each make a total of ₹5. 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 5.

questions.question: Which of these is a NOTE (not a coin)?
questions.explanation: ₹10 can be both a coin and a note. ₹1, ₹2 and ₹5 are coins. ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100 are notes.

questions.question: Riya has two ₹2 coins. How much money does she have?
What is the value of a ₹50 note?
questions.explanation: A ₹50 note has the value of fifty rupees, written as ₹50.

questions.question: Which note has the LARGEST value among these?
Arjun has one ₹10 coin. How many ₹2 coins equal the same amount?
questions.explanation: 5 coins of ₹2 = ₹2 × 5 = ₹10. So 5 coins of ₹2 equal one ₹10 coin.

questions.question: Priya has a ₹10 note and a ₹5 coin. How much money does she have in all?
questions.explanation: ₹10 + ₹5 = ₹15. She has fifteen rupees in total.

questions.question: Which combination equals ₹10?
questions.explanation: Two ₹5 coins = ₹5 + ₹5 = ₹10. The other options: two ₹2 + one ₹5 = ₹9; three ₹2 = ₹6; four ₹2 = ₹8.

questions.question: How many ₹10 notes make one ₹100 note?
questions.explanation: 10 notes of ₹10 = ₹10 × 10 = ₹100. So ten ₹10 notes equal one ₹100 note.

questions.question: Sonu has three ₹5 coins and one ₹2 coin. How much money does he have?
Which of the following has the SMALLEST value?
questions.explanation: ₹2 < ₹5 < ₹10 < ₹20. The ₹2 coin has the smallest value among these options.

questions.question: Meena has two ₹50 notes. How much money does she have?
questions.explanation: Two ₹50 notes = ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹100. Two fifty-rupee notes make one hundred rupees.

questions.question: Rahul wants to make ₹20 using only ₹5 coins. How many coins does he need?
questions.explanation: ₹5 × 4 = ₹20. Rahul needs 4 coins of ₹5 to make twenty rupees.

questions.question: Tina has a ₹100 note, a ₹20 note and a ₹10 note. How much does she have in all?
questions.explanation: ₹100 + ₹20 + ₹10 = ₹130. One hundred plus twenty plus ten equals one hundred and thirty.
